blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) architectures scale model capacity efficiently, yet their substantial memory footprint poses a major barrier to deployment. Expert pruning reduces this footprint, but most methods focus on which experts to remove and prune every layer equally. We propose SPARE (Sparsity Allocation via Routing Entropy), a training-free, selector-agnostic method that decides how many experts to remove from each layer using routing entropy, the entropy of tokens' normalized Top-K gate weights on calibration data. When a token's gate weight is spread evenly, removing one active expert discards little of it, so SPARE prunes layers with more diffuse routing more aggressively. A perturbation bound under random pruning formalizes this intuition, and controlled interventions with a fixed selector link concentrated routing to larger output changes. With the same selector and budget, SPARE improves average accuracy over uniform allocation on Mixtral, Qwen3, and DeepSeek models, especially at high pruning ratios. At 50% expert pruning, it raises the eight-task average of Qwen3-30B-A3B from 57.2% to 63.8%, and the math, code, and science average of DeepSeek-R1 from 80.1 to 82.8.
blocks.zh: Mixture-of-Experts(MOE)架构高效地规模模型容量,然而其实质性的内存足迹对部署构成重大障碍. 专家钻探可以减少这种足迹,但大多数方法都侧重于专家如何同样去除和推倒每一层。 我们提出SPARE(通过Routing Entropy进行平分分配),这是一种无训练的,选择性的,不可知的方法,它决定使用路由式的 en来从每层清除出多少专家,即信使正常化的上-K门在校正数据上的权重. 当一个信使的门重量分布均匀时,去掉一个活跃的专家弃置的几分,所以SPARE用更分散的路由来推倒多层. 由随机冲压所束缚的扰动使这种直觉正式化,用固定的选取器连接的可控干预集中通向更大的输出变化. SPARE使用相同的选取器和预算,比Mixtral,Qune3和DeepSeek模型的统一分配提高了平均准确度,特别是在高出跑率的情况下. 专家出行率达到50%,将"Qune3-30B-A3B"的8个任务平均值从57.2%提高到了63.8%,将"DeepSeek-R1"的数学,代码和科学平均值从80.1%提高到了82.8%.

blocks.en: 1 Introduction
blocks.zh: 导言

blocks.en: The pursuit of stronger reasoning capabilities has pushed Large Language Models (LLMs) to the trillion-parameter scale, incurring prohibitive computational costs. The Mixture-of-Experts (MoEs) architecture addresses this challenge through conditional computation , which activates only a sparse subset of parameters per input token ( Shazeer et al., 2017 ; Lepikhin et al., 2020 ; Fedus et al., 2022 ; Dai et al., 2024 ) . While conditional computation drastically reduces FLOPs, the memory overhead necessitates loading the full set of experts. Furthermore, the requirement to distribute these experts across devices complicates the communication topology, leading to efficiency bottlenecks. This highlights the urgent need for compression techniques capable of shrinking pre-trained MoEs.
blocks.zh: 追求更强的推理能力,将大语言模型(LLMs)推向了万亿参数尺度,造成了令人望而却步的计算成本. Mixture-of-Experts(MoEs)架构通过有条件的计算来应对这一挑战,每个输入符只激活一小部分参数(Shazeer等人,2017年;Lepikhin等人,2020年;Fedus等人,2022年;Dai等人,2024年). 虽然有条件的计算大大减少了FLOP,但内存管理费需要加载全套专家。 此外,要求将这些专家分配到各种设备,使通信地形复杂化,导致效率瓶颈。 这突出表明,迫切需要压缩技术,以便能够缩小事先受过训练的教育部。

blocks.en:
To address this, recent research has focused on expert pruning, which removes entire experts to reduce model size. Existing approaches usually estimate an expert-level importance score from activation frequency, routing statistics, or reconstruction error ( Dong et al., 2025 ; Lasby et al., 2025 ) .
These scores provide useful criteria for selecting experts within a layer. However, using expert importance directly for cross-layer pruning is less reliable. Scores computed in different layers are not necessarily calibrated, since activation scales, expert functions, and token distributions vary across depth. The calibration domain can further change which experts appear important. As a result, globally ranking experts across all layers may over-prune sensitive layers ( Chowdhury et al., 2024 ; Lasby et al., 2025 ) .
blocks.zh:
为了解决这个问题,最近的研究侧重于专家钻探,从而将全部专家赶离以减少模型尺寸。 现行办法通常估计从激活频率、路径统计或重建错误中得出专家一级的重要性分数(Dong等人,2025年;Lasby等人,2025年)。
这些分数为在一层内挑选专家提供了有用的标准。 然而,直接利用专家的重要性进行跨层的挤压则不那么可靠。 按不同层次计算的分数不一定校准,因为激活尺度、专家功能和符号分布因深度而异。 校准领域可进一步改变专家看来重要的领域。 因此,全球各级专家可能过度拥挤敏感层(乔杜里等人,2024年;拉斯比等人,2025年)。

blocks.en:
This limitation comes from conflating two decisions: inter-layer allocation , which determines how many experts to remove from each layer under a global budget, and intra-layer selection , which determines which experts to remove within a layer. Existing criteria such as REAP and EASY-EP address the second; SPARE addresses the first and can be paired with any of them.
Non-uniform allocation has been explored in dense LLMs ( Men et al., 2025 ; Yin et al., 2024 ) and, more recently, in MoE expert pruning ( Yang et al., 2024 ; Li et al., 2026 ) , using signals such as calibration loss or expert-usage frequency. SPARE instead allocates budgets by how gate weight is distributed among each token’s active experts, a training-free signal distinct from usage statistics across inputs.
blocks.zh:
这一限制来自两个决定:一个是各层之间分配,决定在全球预算下从每一层中清除多少专家;另一个是各层内部选择,决定在某一层中清除哪些专家。 现有标准,如REAP和EASY-EP处理第二个问题;SPARE处理第一个问题,可以与任何一个问题对齐。
在密集的LLMs(Men等人,2025年;Yin等人,2024年)和最近的MOE专家钻探(Yang等人,2024年;Li等人,2026年)中,利用校准丢失或专家使用频率等信号探索了非统一配置. SPARE则按照每个信使的活跃专家如何分配大门权重来分配预算,这是与各种投入的使用情况统计不同的无培训信号。

blocks.en: To capture these routing dynamics, we use routing entropy : the Shannon entropy of each token’s normalized Top- K K gate weights, averaged over calibration tokens. As illustrated in Figure 1 , high-entropy layers spread gate weight broadly among the active experts, so removing one active expert discards only a small share of each token’s weight, which is then reassigned to the remaining experts. Low-entropy layers concentrate weight on fewer experts, suggesting stronger input-conditioned specialization and making aggressive pruning riskier. This signal is layer-level rather than expert-level: it assumes neither that particular experts are indispensable nor that the same experts are selected across domains. Although expert identities shift between web text, code, math, and science, layer-wise entropy rankings remain stable across calibration domains, making them a robust basis for allocation.

blocks.en:
Leveraging this insight, we introduce SPARE , a training-free sparsity allocation framework
that assigns non-uniform pruning budgets across MoE layers. Our main contributions are: • Entropy-guided, plug-and-play allocation. We formulate MoE expert pruning as an inter-layer budget allocation problem and replace uniform allocation with entropy-aware budgets. SPARE decides how many experts to prune in each layer, while existing criteria such as REAP and EASY-EP decide which ones, without retraining or modifying the router. • Theoretical foundation. We derive a perturbation bound that, under uniform random pruning, grows with the routing entropy gap. The analysis provides a layer-level sensitivity signal and an existence argument for deterministic masks. • Empirical validation. With the same selector and budget, SPARE improves average accuracy over uniform allocation on Mixtral, Qwen3, and DeepSeek models, especially at high pruning ratios. At 50% expert pruning, it raises the eight-task average of Qwen3-30B-A3B from 57.2% to 63.8%, and the math, code, and science average of DeepSeek-R1 from 80.1 to 82.8.

blocks.en: 2 Related Work
blocks.zh: 2 相关工作

blocks.en:
MoEs scale model capacity through conditional computation ( Shazeer et al., 2017 ; Fedus et al., 2022 ) .
Despite load-balancing objectives, expert behavior can remain non-uniform: Su et al. (2025) identify “super-experts” that produce extreme activation outliers, and Lo et al. (2024) examine relationships between routing weights and expert outputs. These observations motivate studying routing heterogeneity across layers.

尽管有平衡负载的目标,但专家行为仍不能统一: Su等人(2025年)确定了产生极端活性异常的“超级专家”,Lo等人。 (2024)审查路线权重与专家产出之间的关系. 这些观测促使研究跨层的路由异质性.

blocks.en:
Expert pruning reduces the memory footprint of pretrained MoEs. Selection criteria use routing statistics ( Dong et al., 2025 ; Koishekenov et al., 2023 ) , router-weighted activation saliency ( Lasby et al., 2025 ) , or reconstruction loss ( Lu et al., 2024 ) ; EEP ( Liu et al., 2024 ) instead uses evolutionary search.
Shapley-MoE ( Huang et al., 2025 ) ranks experts globally across layers via router-guided sampling; we exclude it from comparisons under fixed layer budgets, which would alter its selection rule. Chowdhury et al. (2024) provide a pruning guarantee for fine-tuned sparse MoEs based on changes in router distributions. SEER-MoE ( Muzio et al., 2024 ) , MoE-SVD ( Li et al., 2025 ) , and AdaWhiten ( Anonymous, 2026 ) explore further pruning and decomposition strategies, alongside task-specific pruning ( Chen et al., 2022 ) and benchmarks such as MC-Suite ( Jaiswal et al., 2025 ) . Expert merging, skipping, dynamic Top- K K routing, and intra-expert pruning ( Xie et al., 2024 ) operate at other granularities; SPARE instead targets budget allocation.

SEER-MoE(Muzio等人,2024年),MOE-SVD(Li等人,2025年),以及AdaWhiten(匿名,2026年),在具体任务审查(Chen等人,2022年)和MC-Suite等基准(Jaiswal等人,2025年)的同时,探索进一步挖掘和分解战略。 专家合并、跳过、动态的Top-K K线路,以及专家内部的挤压(Xie等人,2024年)在其他颗粒区运作;而SPARE则以预算拨款为目标。

blocks.en:
In dense LLMs, ShortGPT ( Men et al., 2025 ) studies
block removal, whereas OWL ( Yin et al., 2024 ) allocates weight sparsity using activation-aware
outlier statistics. SlimGPT ( Ling et al., 2024 ) also adopts non-uniform pruning schedules.
For MoEs, MoE-I 2 ( Yang et al., 2024 ) estimates layer importance from calibration losses after
removing individual experts, assigns non-uniform pruning ratios, and selects experts through
genetic and block-wise search; its full pipeline additionally includes low-rank decomposition and LoRA recovery.
C-GNN-PRUNE ( Li et al., 2026 ) computes the entropy of expert-selection frequencies pooled over calibration samples and retains more experts in layers with higher usage entropy. Its expert-selection procedure uses learned graph embeddings. SPARE averages, over tokens, the entropy of each token’s normalized Top- K K gate weights and prunes more experts in layers with higher gate entropy. Usage entropy describes how broadly expert identities are used across inputs; gate entropy describes how evenly weight is spread among the experts active for a single token. The rules therefore treat high entropy in opposite ways without contradiction: they measure different distributions. SPARE contributes this routing signal and a selector-independent allocation rule.

blocks.en: 4 Theoretical Analysis: Routing-Entropy Perturbation Bounds
blocks.zh: 4 理论分析:运行-诱导扰动

blocks.en:
We analyze how routing entropy can guide the allocation of a fixed expert-pruning budget across layers.
Under the stated routing and bounded-output assumptions, we first bound the output perturbation for any fixed pruning mask using the routing mass assigned to removed experts.
For uniform random pruning, this bound takes an explicit form involving the routing entropy gap.
We then give a sufficient condition under which a deterministic expert selector inherits the same entropy-dependent bound, with an additive term when the condition holds approximately.
Finally, we describe how local pruning perturbations propagate through the network.

blocks.en: We ask three questions: (RQ1) Does entropy-guided allocation improve benchmark performance over uniform allocation at the same pruning budget? (RQ2) Does the gain persist across the evaluated expert selectors, and does entropy correlate with pruning risk when the selector is fixed? blocks.en: 7 Conclusion and Future Work
blocks.zh: 7 结论和今后的工作

blocks.en: We introduced SPARE, a training-free method that uses token-level routing entropy to allocate expert-pruning budgets across MoE language-model layers and can be paired with existing intra-layer selectors. A perturbation analysis and controlled interventions with a fixed selector associate concentrated routing with greater pruning risk. Under the same expert selector and global budget, SPARE improves average performance in the evaluated settings, with larger gains at high pruning ratios: at 50% expert pruning, it raises the Qwen3-30B-A3B eight-task average from 57.2% to 63.8%, and the DeepSeek-R1 three-benchmark average from 80.1 to 82.8, close to the unpruned 83.4. Future work includes studying calibration shift and combining entropy-guided allocation with quantization and expert merging.
blocks.zh: 我们引入了SPARE,这是一种无培训方法,它使用符号级的路由 en来分配整个教育部语言模型层的专家推算预算,并且可以与现有的层内选择者配对. 与固定选手关联的扰动分析和有控制的干预,集中的路由,具有更大的挤压风险. 在同一专家选择器和全球预算中,SPARE提高了被评价环境中的平均业绩,在高推算率下收益更大:在专家推算50%时,将Qune3-30B-A3B的8个任务平均从57.2%提高到63.8%,深层Seek-R1的3个基准平均从80.1提高到82.8,接近未推算的83.4。 未来的工作包括研究校准偏移,将肽导分配与量化和专家合并相结合.

blocks.en: Limitations
blocks.zh: 限制

blocks.en: SPARE yields its largest gains at aggressive pruning ratios; at moderate ratios such as 25%, its improvements over uniform allocation are small. We study SPARE only for expert pruning; combining it with quantization or expert merging is left for future work.
